exposure: maternal thyroid hormones (TSH, free T3, free T4)
cohort: 110 late-pregnant women attending Al-Alkhadimiya Teaching Hospital in Baghdad.
finding: Maternal BMI, age, and free T3 levels significantly influence fetal weight and delivery outcomes, while FT4 and TSH levels do not show such an association.
mod_finding: Obese women were more likely to have natural births and deliver heavier babies.
